description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to auto-translation and translation objects within the Mattermost project, including translation states, types, validation, and context handling for auto-translation paths.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Translation object, copying all fields including nested and optional data.

methods.name: ToPostTranslation
methods.description: Converts a Translation object into a PostTranslation object, extracting source language from meta and including either text or object JSON based on translation type.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the Translation object, checking required fields and consistency based on translation state and type.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns an error message indicating auto-translation feature unavailability, with optional reason.
